subject.title: Record stale foreground final suppression in transcripts

question: Should this PR publish `appendBeforeDeliverCancelled` as part of the plugin-facing `ReplyDispatcher` contract, or keep the cancellation observer internal while fixing the Slack transcript marker bug?
rationale: `ReplyDispatcher` is re-exported through `openclaw/plugin-sdk/reply-runtime`, and repository policy treats plugin API expansions as compatibility-sensitive; automation cannot safely choose the permanent API boundary.

options.title: Keep Observer Internal
options.body: Use a core-internal dispatcher capability or narrowed type for suppressed-final capture so the bug fix lands without adding a new plugin SDK method.

options.title: Publish The SDK Method
options.body: Accept the new optional method as public plugin API and update the SDK baseline/docs plus compatibility proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For Proof First
options.body: Defer the API choice until a live Slack reproduction or redacted runtime log proves the branch fixes the reported race end to end.

recommendation.title: Keep Observer Internal
recommendation.body: Use a core-internal dispatcher capability or narrowed type for suppressed-final capture so the bug fix lands without adding a new plugin SDK method.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest recent cross-surface owner for auto-reply, session, and plugin SDK policy decisions in this area.
